data.siteTitle: AI, Automation & Software for Small Businesses — Chinvat Bridge
data.siteDescription: UK-based technology consultancy for small businesses worldwide: AI integration, workflow automation, custom software and technical SEO, built around your work.
data.siteOrigin: The name comes from the Chinvat Bridge of ancient Persian tradition, the crossing where a person's own conscience meets them, and stands for the move from how a business works today to how it could work tomorrow.
data.ogImageAlt: Chinvat Bridge: AI, automation, software and SEO. The mark is split down its axis, flat ink on one side and iridescent glass on the other.

footer.blurb: Chinvat Bridge is a UK-based technology consultancy helping businesses use AI, automation, software and SEO to work better and grow.
